meta.settlement_policy: No automatic settlement. Require the venue’s actual resolution (including any partial/void rules), plus independent HLTV and Liquipedia result confirmation; check for conflicts before recording outcome and payout. Outright: verify official tournament winner and venue resolution. Unverified results remain pending.
meta.payout_formula: Gross, fee-free simulation: win = stake / raw_ask; loss = 0; venue-approved void = stake. profit = payout - stake. Partial/50-50 resolves from venue’s actual payout fraction; do not assume void.
meta.prediction_share_conversion: A $1 Yes share at first-party best ask p converts to gross decimal_odds = 1/p for simulation. Historical/book quotes are NOT executed trades. Fees, slippage and tax excluded; top-of-book depth required for the amount modeled.
meta.note: Empty by policy: no timestamped, first-party pre-event Finals price with BOTH eligible outright asks captured yet. Resolved qualifier market prices are NOT usable as earlier asks.
